creator: kidfriendly.meals
title: Ricotta Pesto
summary: This ricotta pesto is creamy, fresh, and ready in 5 minutes. A simple, kid-friendly sauce for pasta, toast, sandwiches, and more.
steps: Add all the ingredients into a food processor or high-powered blender. Blend until smooth.
Adjust to your liking - taste and season with salt and black pepper, add more lemon juice, garlic, parmesan, etc. If you desire a thinner consistency, add more extra virgin olive oil and blend.
